# FilesKmp {{VERSION}}

| 平台 | 安裝版 | 免安裝版 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows x64（Intel / AMD 64 位元） | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64.msi` | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| Windows ARM64 | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-arm64.msi` | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-arm64-portable.zip` |

兩種版本皆內含對應架構的 Java runtime，無須另外安裝 Java。
免安裝版請完整解壓後執行 `FilesKmp/FilesKmp.exe`。
每種架構附有 SHA256SUMS 檔供核對下載內容。安裝包尚未設定程式碼簽章。

操作說明：[繁體中文使用者手冊](https://github.com/creamgod45/FilesKmp/blob/v{{VERSION}}/docs/USER-GUIDE.zh-TW.md)。
功能變更：[繁體中文更新紀錄](https://github.com/creamgod45/FilesKmp/blob/v{{VERSION}}/CHANGELOG.md)。
文件連結指向此版本的標籤；較早版本若尚未包含文件，可至儲存庫首頁查閱。

## English

| Platform | Installer | Portable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows x64 (Intel / AMD 64-bit) | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64.msi` | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| Windows ARM64 | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-arm64.msi` | `FilesKmp-{{VERSION}}-windows-arm64-portable.zip` |

Both packages include the Java runtime for their architecture; no separate Java installation is required.
Extract the complete portable ZIP, then launch `FilesKmp/FilesKmp.exe`.
Each architecture includes a SHA256SUMS file for download verification. Code signing is not currently configured.

Instructions: [English user guide](https://github.com/creamgod45/FilesKmp/blob/v{{VERSION}}/docs/USER-GUIDE.en.md).
Changes: [English changelog](https://github.com/creamgod45/FilesKmp/blob/v{{VERSION}}/CHANGELOG.en.md).
Documentation links target this version's tag. For older tags without these documents, consult the repository home page.
